mandatory_vocabulary.C: conditional: mapped only if source exists, never rejects (undefined in workbook)

date_dialect.yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSXXX: 3 millisecond digits, offset kept, Z for zero offset
date_dialect.yyyy-MM-dd: date as written in source, no tz conversion

null_rule: null, empty and missing are equivalent; optional target field without value is omitted
strikethrough: struck rows are removed from the interface and are not mapped
